package cache

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"project_id/internal/config"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// TestMemoryTTLIsolationAndEviction 验证复制语义、LRU、TTL、容量和关闭边界。
func TestMemoryTTLIsolationAndEviction(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	store, err := New(ctx, config.Cache{Capacity: 2, MaxBytes: 4})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	value := []byte("one")
	if store.Set(ctx, "a", value, time.Hour) != nil {
		t.Fatal("set")
	}
	value[0] = 'X'
	if store.Set(ctx, "b", []byte("two"), time.Hour) != nil {
		t.Fatal("set b")
	}
	actual, found, err := store.Get(ctx, "a")
	if err != nil || !found || string(actual) != "one" {
		t.Fatal("copy")
	}
	actual[0] = 'Y'
	if store.Set(ctx, "c", []byte("new"), time.Hour) != nil {
		t.Fatal("set c")
	}
	if _, found, _ := store.Get(ctx, "b"); found {
		t.Fatal("LRU")
	}
	if err := store.Set(ctx, "large", []byte("large"), time.Hour); !errors.Is(err, ErrCapacity) {
		t.Fatal("size")
	}
	if err := store.Set(ctx, "bad", nil, 0); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("ttl")
	}
	// 测试直接推进当前条目过期，不依赖真实等待。
	store.mu.Lock()
	element := store.items["a"]
	expired := element.Value.(entry)
	expired.expires = time.Now().Add(-time.Second)
	element.Value = expired
	store.mu.Unlock()
	if _, found, _ := store.Get(ctx, "a"); found {
		t.Fatal("expiry")
	}
	if store.Delete(ctx, "c") != nil {
		t.Fatal("delete")
	}
	if _, found, _ := store.Get(ctx, "c"); found {
		t.Fatal("delete result")
	}
	cancelled, cancel := context.WithCancel(ctx)
	cancel()
	if store.Set(cancelled, "a", nil, time.Hour) == nil {
		t.Fatal("cancel")
	}
	_ = store.Close()
	_ = store.Close()
	if _, _, err := store.Get(ctx, "a"); !errors.Is(err, ErrClosed) {
		t.Fatal("closed")
	}
}
